region_scene_page.compact: Power pop is rock's recurring promise that a perfect chorus can still hit hard.
region_scene_page.standard: Power pop is rock's recurring promise that a perfect chorus can still hit hard. Badfinger's Baby Blue, The Records' Starry Eyes, Raspberries' Go All the Way, and Big Star's In the Street give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Power pop is rock's recurring promise that a perfect chorus can still hit hard. The guitars have teeth, but the song is built to be sung back immediately. Badfinger's Baby Blue, The Records' Starry Eyes, Raspberries' Go All the Way, and Big Star's In the Street give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
